memory_update.text: AVGO should remain a core AI networking candidate because its public disclosures explicitly tie growth to Ethernet AI switches and custom AI accelerators.
ANET is a clean public-market mapping for AI Ethernet systems and software; next pass should verify AI networking revenue and hyperscaler concentration.
COHR is a strong optical-layer candidate with direct 800G/1.6T, CPO, silicon photonics, and optical circuit switch exposure.
CRDO is a less obvious AI connectivity supplier through active electrical cables, SerDes, retimers/DSPs, and short-reach cluster interconnect exposure.
GLW should be tracked as an adjacent physical-connectivity chokepoint: fiber density, cables, connectors, and data-center optical infrastructure may become constrained as AI data centers scale.

Potential next-pass candidates not included due to the 5-name limit: MRVL for optical DSP/custom silicon/silicon photonics; LITE for EML lasers, pump lasers, 800G transceivers and CPO components; FN for outsourced optical manufacturing; CIEN for coherent DCI; NVDA for InfiniBand, Spectrum-X Ethernet, NVLink and AI networking systems.

The strongest sub-nodes to track are: Ethernet switch ASICs, high-speed switching systems, 800G/1.6T optical transceivers, laser components, silicon photonics, active electrical cables, SerDes/DSPs, and high-density fiber/connectors.

node: AI cluster networking, Ethernet/InfiniBand, optical modules, fiber and silicon photonics
summary: Expanded the public-market universe for the AI cluster networking and optics node. The strongest direct exposures found in this pass are Ethernet switching systems, merchant/custom networking silicon, optical transceivers/components, active electrical cables/SerDes, and high-density fiber/connectivity infrastructure. The working hypothesis is that as AI clusters scale, east-west traffic, accelerator utilization, power per bit, and deployment density make networking and optical connectivity a second-order bottleneck behind compute. Candidate inclusion is for research tracking only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
